subject: BLOCKER native iOS -Werror: compute_frontend.m:736 pointer-bool-conversion
body: clang --target=arm64-apple-ios16.0 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsyntax-only (same flags as gpu/tools/build_tegu_frontend_objects.sh) fails: 'if(tegu_mali_compile_compute_v2)' address of function always true. The symbol is not declared weak in the visible declaration, so the startup gate is also semantically meaningless. Fix in your file: declare it __attribute__((weak_import)) (or weak) where used and test '&tegu_mali_compile_compute_v2 != NULL', or gate on a real runtime capability. nord2_metal_bridge.c and nord2_metal_render.c pass -fsyntax-only. Please rerun the exact frontend syntax check after fixing.
